profile.name: TCA6408A 八位 I²C GPIO 扩展器
profile.description: TCA6408A 是一款通过 I²C 接口提供 8 路可配置数字输入/输出的 GPIO 扩展芯片，常用于嵌入式原型、测试夹具和实验电路中扩展微控制器的数字引脚。它支持输入端口读取、输出端口控制、极性反转以及引脚方向配置。
profile.description_en: The TCA6408A is an 8-bit GPIO expander that adds configurable digital input/output lines over an I2C interface. It is commonly used in embedded prototypes, test fixtures, and lab electronics to expand the digital I/O of a microcontroller, with support for input reading, output control, polarity inversion, and pin direction configuration.
